title: An Empirically Audited Machine Learning and Stochastic Inventory Control Framework for Enterprise Replenishment Decision Support
description: Replication package and empirical research codebase for evaluating machine learning retail demand forecasting under asymmetric inventory loss and continuous-review (s, Q) replenishment control. Includes leakage-safe walk-forward validation routines, Eve's Law lead-time variance decomposition, dual-moment Jensen inequality smearing corrections, Platt-calibrated demand surge classification, and 8,000-step event-driven continuous simulation benchmarking.
